title: psycopg v3 search regressions: test through a postgresql+psycopg store, since the generic DB fixture does not force the driver
answers: How do I write a test that catches a PostgreSQL psycopg v3 bind error in tracking or registry search?
Why did my search test pass on SQLite and psycopg2 but the psycopg v3 bug still shipped?
How do I build a store that uses the psycopg v3 driver from MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI in tests?
Why was the sqlalchemy dependency pinned to allow the 2.1 release in CI?
body:
Path: tests/db/test_workspace_tracking_store.py holds the PostgreSQL-only store fixtures. `_psycopg3_uri` converts the MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI into a `postgresql+psycopg://` URL and skips when the URI is not PostgreSQL or `psycopg` is not importable. `psycopg3_store` and `psycopg3_registry_store` build WorkspaceAware tracking and registry stores on that URL.
Rule: To regression-test a numeric or string bind on psycopg v3, use `psycopg3_store` (tracking) or `psycopg3_registry_store` (model registry) instead of the generic `store` fixture. The generic fixture runs on SQLite or psycopg2, which accept an untyped string and hide the VARCHAR bug. Assert a valid filter succeeds, not only that invalid input raises.
Symptom: The psycopg v3 bind bug could regress without failing CI, because the generic fixtures never exercised psycopg v3.
Constraints: Runs only when the test database is PostgreSQL and psycopg is installed; otherwise the tests skip. Separately, pyproject.toml's `[tool.uv] exclude-newer-package` sets `sqlalchemy = false` with a TODO, so CI resolves SQLAlchemy 2.1.0 (bare postgresql:// becomes psycopg v3). Remove that override after the cooldown expires.
applies: Adding or changing PostgreSQL tests for tracking or model-registry search filters where the driver matters; not for SQLite-only tests.
says: Searching experiment runs crashes when connected to a PostgreSQL database backend.
Model registry search queries fail with type errors on newer database drivers.
Filtering models or tracking records by numeric values breaks on PostgreSQL.
Ensure automated tests catch database driver binding bugs before shipping updates.
search: Testing tracking and model-registry search filters against psycopg v3 requires using psycopg3_store or psycopg3_registry_store fixtures in tests/db/test_workspace_tracking_store.py rather than the generic store fixture. The generic fixture defaults to SQLite or psycopg2 and masks VARCHAR binding bugs, so tests must assert that valid filters succeed against postgresql+psycopg:// URLs converted by _psycopg3_uri from MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI. Applies to PostgreSQL tracking and model-registry search tests where the database is PostgreSQL and psycopg is importable, alongside a pyproject.toml sqlalchemy exclude-newer-package override for SQLAlchemy 2.1.0 in CI.
